data.definition: The assessment of engineering students' leadership abilities, including self-efficacy in leadership roles, team motivation, ethical decision-making, and programmatic development of leadership skills. This theme encompasses validated scales and contextual applications in engineering curricula.

data.theme: Biomedical Engineering Self-Efficacy in Clinical Contexts
data.definition: The measurement of perceived competence among biomedical engineering students in addressing clinical problems, including grant writing and solution proposal. This theme focuses on instrument validation and contextual relevance in healthcare settings.

data.theme: Affective and Motivational Competencies in Engineering Writing
data.definition: The exploration of emotional and attitudinal factors influencing engineering students' writing performance, including writing apprehension, writer's block, and motivation. This theme includes the development and validation of survey instruments to assess these affective dimensions.
